name: Accordion · requirements checklist
description: Light-green accordion listing what to prepare.

items.question: Proof of identity
items.answer: A valid passport or national ID card. Scans or clear phone photos are fine.

items.question: Proof of address
items.answer: A utility bill or bank statement dated within the last three months.

items.question: Proof of income
items.answer: Your last three payslips, or two years of accounts if you are self-employed.

items.question: Application form
items.answer: Complete it online in about ten minutes. You can save and return at any time.
